name: Mythic Tales Skill
purpose: Entry point for films that retell myths, legends and sacred stories (Hindu epics and Puranas, Jain and Buddhist tales, Greek and Roman, Norse) in the mythic-tale style template: routes to the tradition pack, storytelling, design-language, imagery-sourcing, scene-recipe and quality references, with a storyteller stance and an iconography gate on top of the studio pipeline.
capabilities: Workflow from episode and telling to render: scaffold (mythic-film), research dossier contents, arcs and hooks, images, audio, kit composition, gates
Tradition packs with tellings, public-domain translations, iconography checklists, art forms and sensitivities (indian, jain-buddhist, greek-roman, norse)
Design language: style chooser across mythic-paper, shadow-lantern, painted-folio and carved-relief; signature moves mapped to Studio.kit.mythic; sourced research
Imagery: myth-sources.py search, collage fetcher, asset import, the generated-still protocol and credits
Quality rubric: telling, iconography, respect and sources gates plus creative-review additions

compatibility.notes: Light commands only; renders go through studio.py build on the render host.

licensing.notes: Written for this workspace from web research (sources linked inline); no third-party text copied.

security.notes: Network only through scripts/myth-sources.py and the collage fetcher (public APIs, no keys); generated stills go through scripts/assets.py with the key in the environment only.

approval_evidence: Created 2026-11-23; the mythic-film scaffold and four style samples (Hanuman's leap in every look) validated and frame-reviewed; figure library and motif sheets reviewed by eye; no film rendered yet.
